summary: Henry County, AL tower built by the Alabama Forestry Commission in 1960; NHLR-registered 2009 as US 844; now decommissioned and privately owned, with no public access described.

facts.status_note: Register says it has been decommissioned and is privately owned; no statement of current condition or recent photo found
facts.agency: George & Rebecca Taylor (administrators per NHLR); built by the Alabama Forestry Commission

access.note: Decommissioned and now privately owned per NHLR; no public access described in the sources read

events.note: Built by the Alabama Forestry Commission (NHLR 'Built' field and description)
Registered December 2, 2009 as US 844, AL 23; nominated by Thomas Kaufmann

evidence.supports: tower was built by the Alabama Forestry Commission in 1960
evidence.quote: was built by the Alabama Forestry Commission in 1960

evidence.supports: design: 100-foot Aermotor MC-39 tower with 7 by 7 foot cab
Forest Lookouts lists the tower under Henry County and Alabama Forestry Commission

notes_for_editor: Standing is not confirmed: the Register describes the tower as decommissioned and privately owned, but no statement of current condition or recent photo was found, so facts.status is 'unknown'. Owner names appear in the Register description and are left out of the story and evidence quotes. The brief's 'George & Rebecca Taylor' is the Register's administrator field and was kept. The Forest Lookouts page has only a county and agency line. The Jackson's Ramblings post and the 1819 News column add nothing new on this tower. Used 1 WebSearch and about 7 page reads, over the per-tower budget, because the sources are thin.
